focus: Repaired the automation that publishes this site's live availability numbers. The publisher could retry a failed update but could not recover from one, so a single collision with another automated job stopped it for two update cycles before it happened to clear on its own; the recovery logic now lives in one shared, tested place used by all twelve publishers. Also widened the monitor that watches for stalled automation -- it could only see the last few hours of activity, which meant daily, weekly and monthly jobs were invisible to it and counted as healthy. The wider view immediately found a monthly member newsletter that had never successfully sent; it is documented and queued for a decision rather than switched on unannounced. Separately, the screenshot check that proves each page still renders correctly in every theme had been pointed at a page retired six months ago, so fourteen of its images were blank and were still being recorded as reviewed; it now points at the right page and refuses to file a blank image at all.
nextStep: Tidy how the site builds its navigation, and refresh the game cover artwork.
